boundary_price_definition.ask_diagnostics: Ask extremes and Bid/Ask spread are retained for audit but do not redefine Atlas-compatible event identity
boundary_price_definition.previous_day_high: maximum source-native Bid during the previous trading-day interval
boundary_price_definition.previous_day_low: minimum source-native Bid during the previous trading-day interval
boundary_price_definition.reclaim: Bid returns strictly inside the boundary
boundary_price_definition.sweep_cross: Bid > previous_day_high for High sweep; Bid < previous_day_low for Low sweep

previous_day_calendar_contract.eligible_trading_day: weekday with source-native ticks and complete-day coverage under the completeness contract
previous_day_calendar_contract.holiday_rule: skip only when the source manifest proves no ticks for the entire UTC day and adjacent eligible days pass completeness
previous_day_calendar_contract.missing_tick_day_rule: unexplained missing eligible weekday is a binding source-authority failure
previous_day_calendar_contract.monday_rule: normally Friday; otherwise latest prior complete eligible trading day
previous_day_calendar_contract.partial_day_rule: do not use as a boundary source and do not bridge silently; block source authority
previous_day_calendar_contract.previous_trading_day: latest prior eligible trading day; Saturday/Sunday and verified no-tick market holidays are skipped
